source: 770 Egg
target: 770 Ovum

source: 710 Egg
target: 710 Ovum

source: For a moment, Lumian was unsure whether the Authority Holder’s Under‐the‐table Transaction, a Beyonder item from the Broker pathway, actually had negative effects.
target: Pro momento, Lumian dubitabat num Transactio sub mensa Tenentis Auctoritatis, res transmundana ex via Negotiatoris, re vera effectus negativos haberet.

source: On the one hand, encountering a deal with Demons and other evil beings surprisingly prevented a potential battle.
target: Ex una parte, congressus cum daemonibus et aliis maleficis entibus, mirum in modum, certamen potentiale impediit.

source: Without this “negative effect,” Lumian suspected he would have been attacked the instant he was spotted by the goat‐faced Demon, instead of being asked if he needed flesh.
target: Sine hoc “effectu negativo,” Lumian suspicabatur se statim oppugnatum fore, quatenus a Daemone vultu caprino deprehenso, pro eo ut interrogaretur an caro desideraret.

source: This seemed like a manifestation of how a Shadow Merchant could reduce the malice from dangerous creatures and mysterious entities.
target: Hoc videbatur esse manifestatio quomodo Mercator Umbrae malitiam creaturarum periculosarum et entium mysteriosorum minuere posset.

source: However, it was definitely wrong if this wasn’t considered a negative effect.
target: Attamen, certe erratum erat, si hoc non habebatur ut effectus negativus.

source: Dealing with a Demon wouldn’t be simple or easy.
target: Negotium cum Daemone non esset simplex neque facilis.

source: It might even be very dangerous, even if the Demon was already dead.
target: Fortasse etiam valde periculosum, etiamsi daemon iam mortuus esset.

source: After a few seconds of deliberation, Lumian, pointing to the half‐body of the Abscessed Hand on the grayish‐white stone table, asked, “I want it all.
target: Post paucas secundas deliberationis, Lumian, ad dimidiatum corpus Manus Abscessae in mensa lapidea cinereo–alba demonstrans, quaesivit: “Omnia volo.

source: What must I give in return?”
target: Quid in vicem dare debeam?

source: He planned to gauge the difficulty of the transaction first.
target: Primum consilium habebat difficultatem transactionis aestimandi.

source: If it proved too challenging, he would ask for help from the temperance faction demigod to confront and collectively eliminate this decaying goat‐faced Demon!
target: Si nimis arduum appareret, auxilium a semideo factionis temperantiae peteret, ut hunc daemonem vultu caprino putrescens oppugnaret et communiter exstirpareret!

source: Having a deal offered by a Demon didn’t mean you had to accept it!
target: Negotium a Daemone oblato non significabat quod id accipere oporteret!

source: As soon as Lumian spoke, he felt his body stiffen and a coldness spread within him.
target: Cum Lumian statim locutus esset, sensit corpus suum rigidum fieri et frigoris sensum intrinsecus diffundi.

source: He understood what was happening and didn’t resist or struggle, then found himself involuntarily speaking in a gravelly, metallic voice, as if using dead vocal cords.
target: Intellexit quid ageretur et nec remisit nec certavit; deinde se invito invenit loquendum voce rauca et metallina, quasi chordas vocales mortuas adhiberet.

source: His words were repeated in an unknown language by the goat‐faced giant, and every word struck a chill into Lumian’s spirit, feeling as though they were piercing his Spirit Body.
target: Verba eius in lingua ignota a giganto vultu caprino repetebantur, et unumquodque verbum frigidum in spiritum Lumiani percutiebat, quasi corpus spirituale eius perforarent.

source: Bent over and goat‐faced, the black‐skinned decaying Demon responded in the same hollow language, its voice echoing ominously.
target: Inclinatus et vultu caprino, daemon putrescens, cum cuti nigrae, respondit in eadem lingua vacua, voce lugubri resonante.

source: One of the words seemed to grasp Lumian’s Spirit Body and body as if by a giant hand.
target: Unum verbum videbatur corpus spiritale Lumiani et corpus eius quasi manu gigantea complecti.

source: If it weren’t for his “dead” state and the protection of the Eggers family’s golden mask, just this interaction alone could have severely harmed him.
target: Nisi ex statu “mortuo” suo et tutela larminae aureae familiae Eggers, sola haec interactio eum graviter laedere potuisset.

source: Soon, the ethereal voice of the Knight of Swords resonated in his mind: “I want Farbauti dead!”
target: Mox, vox aetherica Equis Ensium in mente eius resonabat: “Farbautium mortuum volo!”

source: Farbauti?
target: Farbauti?

source: The Devil Monarch, Farbauti, the true form of Naboredisley?
target: Diabolus Monarchus, Farbauti, veram formam Naboredisley?

source: The terms of the deal require me to kill an ancient god?
target: Pacti condiciones mihi mandant ut deum antiquum occiderem?

source: Lumian narrowed his eyes at the towering goat‐faced devil, regaining control of his voice to say, “That’s an ancient god.
target: Lumian oculos contraxit ad diabolum altum vultu caprino, moderationem vocis recuperans, ut diceret: “Id est deus antiquus.

source: I can’t do it.
target: Non possum.

source: Change the terms.”
target: Muta condiciones.

source: If the goat‐faced devil refused to change the terms, then there was no need for negotiation!
target: Si diabolus vultu caprino condiciones mutare recusaverit, nihil ad contrahendum necessarium erit!

source: Facing an ancient god might be beyond me, but taking you down certainly wasn’t!
target: Oppugnare deum antiquum mihi fortasse impossibile videbatur, sed te superare certe non videbatur!

source: It was just a matter of owing a favor to a demigod!
target: Hoc tantum erat: favorem semidei debere!

source: That debt could be repaid slowly over time!
target: Illud debitum paulatim, tempore solvi poterat!

source: It was unclear whether it was the Knight of Swords or the temperance faction demigod who then took control of Lumian’s body, translating his words into a language the goat‐faced Demon could understand.
target: Non clare patebat utrum Eques Ensium aut semideus factionis temperantiae corpus Lumiani ceperit, verba eius in linguam daemonis vultu caprino intellegibilem converteret.

source: This also brought Lumian a strange sensation.
target: Hoc etiam Lumian sensum mirum attulit.

source: The goat‐faced Demon, capable of standing four to five meters tall but appearing only a bit over three meters due to its bent back, fell silent for a moment before speaking in a deep, hollow tone, “I want that egg.”
target: Daemon vultu caprino, quattuor ad quinque metra altus stare posse, sed propter dorsum incurvum vix paulo plus quam tria metra apparens, paulisper siluit, antequam voce profunda et vacua diceret: “Illud ovum volo.”

source: Egg?
target: Ovum?

source: Lumian muttered to himself in confusion.
target: Lumian sibi, in confusione, submurmuravit.

source: He understood directly because the Knight of Swords had already translated it synchronously.
target: Statim intellexit, nam Eques Ensium id iam simul interpretatus erat.

source: “Where is this egg?” Lumian inquired.
target: “Ubi est hoc ovum?” quaesivit Lumian.

source: As a member of the temperance faction took control of his mouth to relay the question, the decaying goat‐faced Demon let the massive thigh bone in its hand drop to the ground with a loud thud.
target: Dum membrum factionis temperantiae os eius ceperat ad quaestionem referendam, daemon vultu caprino putrescens ossa femorale ingens in manu sua in terram cum magno strepitu deiecit.

source: “In the palace,” the goat‐faced Demon answered simply, making the Knight of Swords’ job of translating much easier.
target: “In palatio,” respondit daemon vultu caprino simpliciter, faciens laborem interpretationis Equis Ensium multo faciliorem.

source: This also made the Knight of Swords’ translation job much easier.
target: Hoc etiam laborem interpretationis Equis Ensium multo faciliorem reddidit.

source: Lumian asked, seeking confirmation, “The palace of Death?”
target: Lumian confirmationem petens quaesivit: “Palatium Mortis?”

source: Could a former divine residence be extremely dangerous?
target: An olim divina residentia valde periculosa esse posset?

source: The goat‐faced Demon’s eyes, oozing blood and pus, shifted slightly.
target: Oculi daemonis vultu caprino, sanguine et suppa fluentes, leviter mutaverunt.

source: Yes.
target: Ita.

source: An egg within Death’s palace…
target: Ovum in palatio Mortis…

source: Lumian hesitated between agreeing to the deal or just seizing it.
target: Lumian inter pactum admittere aut eam tantum arripere haesitavit.

source: As he surveyed his surroundings, he further inquired, “What does this egg look like?”
target: Dum circumiecta contemplabatur, ulterius interrogavit: “Qualis hoc ovum est?”

source: While waiting for the member of the temperance faction to translate, Lumian noticed a broken statue by a half‐buried stone pillar, with only parts of its body remaining.
target: Dum membrum factionis temperantiae interpretationem exspectabat, Lumian statuam fractam iuxta columnam lapideam semi‐sepelitam animadvertit, cui solum partes corporis remaneant.

source: It was vaguely recognizable as an avian statue, its feathers seemingly woven from mystical patterns, pale‐white and dim.
target: Illa vage recognoscibilis erat ut statua avium, quorum plumae quasi ex figuris mysticis contextae, pallide albae et obscurae.

source: An avian statue…
target: Statua avium…

source: Lumian thought, connecting this with the egg the goat‐faced Demon wanted.
target: Lumian cogitavit, hoc cum ovo quod daemon vultu caprino desiderabat coniungens.

source: Once the translation was finished and control of his mouth returned, he added, “A bird’s egg?”
target: Postquam interpretatio confecta est et potestas oris redepta, addidit: “Ovum avium?”

source: After about ten seconds, the goat‐faced Demon dragged its pale thigh bone forward a few steps, which scraped against the ground, producing a grating sound.
target: Post circiter decem secundas, daemon vultu caprino ossa femorale pallida paucis passibus trahebat, quae super terram repediendo sonum stridulentem afferebant.

source: The goat‐faced Demon spoke slowly and intermittently, “Yes.
target: Daemon vultu caprino lente et intermittenter loquebatur, “Ita.

source: It’s large.
target: Illud magnum est.

source: Black, within flames.
target: Nigrum, in flammis.

source: It really is a bird’s egg, and obviously from an abnormal mother…
target: Revera ovum avium est, et manifeste ex matre anormali provenit…

source: Birds…
target: Aves…

source: Lumian suddenly remembered the prematurely born child they were tracking, associated with the Banshees in their full might.
target: Lumian subito recordatus est infanti praecoetu nato, quem insequebantur, qui cum Banshees totius vi coniunctus erat.

source: They resembled birds, with claws and wings!
target: Aves similes erant, cum unguibus et alis!

source: Although there are clear differences from this bird statue, they are at least all birds…
target: Quamquam ab hac statua avium differentiae manifestae sunt, tamen omnes aves sunt…

source: Moreover, since there is an abnormal bird’s egg inside Death’s palace, it implies the existence of a mother, a mother in the mystical sense…
target: Praeterea, cum ovum avium anormalis intra palatium Mortis sit, id existentiam matris, matris mysticae, implicat…

source: Lumian vaguely grasped the reason Oxyto had conceived such a stillborn and cast it into the Underworld.
target: Lumian vage intellexit causam cur Oxyto talem natum mortuum conciperet et in Orcum proiceret.

source: Was her goal also this egg, to use it to do something to the Underworld?
target: Num etiam eius propositum esset hoc ovum ad aliquid in Orco faciendum adhibere?

source: Whether integrating the realm of the dead in the Raklev region into her own Paramita or conducting a ritual to impregnate corpses and bear children, was it all for this purpose?
target: Sive regnum defunctorum in regione Raklev in suam Paramita integrare sive ritum celebrari ad cadavera fecondanda et liberos parendos, omnia ad hoc propositum pertinere videbantur?

source: Sheesh, does she intend to merge the Underworld with her own Paramita?
target: Heu, num illa vult Orcum cum sua Paramita commiscere?

source: That’s quite ambitious, isn’t it?
target: Id certe audax est, nonne?

source: This is a legacy of a true god, a former divine kingdom!
target: Hoc est legatum veri dei, pristinum regnum divinum!

source: But if Oxyto really succeeds, wouldn’t the Great Mother be able to descend directly?
target: Sed si Oxyto vere succedat, nonne Magna Mater directe descendere poterit?

source: Even if she can’t fully merge the Underworld just yet, just planting a seed is still a very dangerous thing for our world!
target: Etiamsi illa Orcum plene coniungere nondum possit, sola semina serere rem valde periculosam pro nostro mundo efficit!

source: Lumian immediately asked the goat‐faced Demon, “Have you seen a giant baby with bird claws?”
target: Lumian statim rogavit daemon vultu caprino: “Num vidistine infantem ingentem cum unguibus avium?”

source: The decaying goat‐faced Demon looked at Lumian but did not respond.
target: Daemon vultu caprino putrescens Lumian spectavit sed non respondit.

source: It was unclear whether it hadn’t seen such a thing, or if the influence of the Broker pathway was limited to the transaction itself.
target: Non clare patebat utrum tale non perspexisset, an influentia viae Negotiatoris solum ad transactionem ipsam restringeretur.

source: Lumian fell silent for a few seconds before stating, “Deal!”
target: Lumian paucis secundis siluit antequam dixerit: “Pactum!”

source: The goat‐faced Demon’s head moved almost imperceptibly.
target: Caput daemonis vultu caprino paene imperceptibiliter movebat.

source: It turned and began dragging its pale thigh bone, step by step, back to the grayish‐white stone table where the half‐body of the Abscessed Hand lay.
target: Se convertere et paulatim ossa femorale pallida, gradatim, retrorsum ad mensam lapideam cinereo–albam, in qua dimidium corporis Manus Abscessae iacebat, trahebat.

source: Lumian, lowering his voice, shared his recent thoughts with the Knight of Swords and the temperance faction demigod.
target: Lumian, vocem deprimens, cogitationes recentes suas cum Eques Ensium et semideo factionis temperantiae communicavit.

source: Knight of Swords Maric quickly responded, “Let’s head to Death’s palace right now.”
target: Eques Ensium Maric celeriter respondit: “Nunc ad palatium Mortis eamus!”

source: Seemingly to reassure Lumian, the Knight of Swords added, “You’re wearing the Eggers family’s mask.
target: Quasi Lumian tranquillandum, Eques Ensium addidit: “Geris larvam auream familiae Eggers.”

source: Many dangers in the Underworld will naturally avoid you.
target: Multa pericula in Orco te naturaliter evitabunt.

source: We only need to worry about anomalies like the boatman.
target: Nobis solum curandum est de anomaliis ut de nauta.

source: And if Oxyto’s monstrous child can get close to Death’s palace, close to that bird’s egg, then we should be able to as well.
target: Et si infans monstruosus Oxyto ad palatium Mortis, iuxta ovum avium, accedat, tunc nos quoque id efficere poterimus.

source: Even with the premature birth and the powers inherited from Oxyto, it’s at most equivalent to a Sequence 4.
target: Etiam cum praecoetu nativitate et viribus ex Oxyto receptis, id tantum est aequipollens Sequentiae IV.

source: Upon hearing the Knight of Swords say so much in one breath, Lumian pondered and said, “Its state of existence and birth ritual are quite unique.
target: Audito a Eques Ensium tantum in uno anhelitu dicere, Lumian meditatus est et inquit: “Status eius existentiae et ritus nativitatis admodum singulares sunt.

source: It might be able to harness some of the Underworld’s power.
target: Forsitan potentiam Orci quandam capere possit.

source: Even if it hasn’t reached the Angelic level due to being premature, we must treat it as a Sequence 3 demigod in the corresponding environment.
target: Etiamsi praecoetu gradum angelicum nondum attigerit, eum in ambitu congruenti ut semideum Sequentiae III considerare debemus.

source: After all, this was a baby born through the integration of Paramita and the spirit realm, facilitated by Lake Dalsh.
target: Postremo, hic erat infans natus per integrationem Paramitae et regni spirituum, quo Lacus Dalsh adiuvabat.

source: And this baby had undergone gestation within a corpse, birth post‐mortem, and then returned to its original form through a process of mutation and integration.
target: Et hic infans gestationem in cadavere subiit, partum post mortem habuit, atque deinde per mutationem et integrationem ad formam originariam rediit.

source: It absolutely couldn’t be considered a living creature, for living beings would instantly die in the Underworld.
target: Certe non poterat censiri creatura viva, nam entia viva in Orco statim interire deberent.

source: “Yes,” the Knight of Swords answered succinctly.
target: “Ita,” respondit Eques Ensium.

source: Under the pale glow of a few bone torches mounted on the broken wall, Lumian asked the two members of the temperance faction within him, “If we continue along the path we were on, into the depths of the darkness, will we reach Death’s palace?”
target: Sub pallido lumine paucarum ossium torcharum in pariete fracto, Lumian duo membrum factionis temperantiae intra se rogavit: “Si iter nostrum in obscuritatem continuaverimus, perveniemusne ad palatium Mortis?”

source: Lumian remembered that the Knight of Swords had mentioned reading many notes from the descendants of Death.
target: Lumian recordatus est Eques Ensium multas annotationes ab descendantibus Mortis legisse.

source: Before the Knight of Swords could reply, the goat‐faced Demon standing at the gray stone table suddenly lifted the large pale thigh bone.
target: Priusquam Eques Ensium responderet, daemon vultu caprino ad mensam lapideam cinereo–albam stans subito levavit magnum ossa femorale pallidum.

source: It used the bone to point toward a dark, deep hole that had been smashed open by a dome‐shaped stone block near the broken statue.
target: Is ossa adhibuit ut monstrasset ad cavum obscurum et profundum, quod lapide globoso prope statuam fractam abruptim apertum erat.

source: That seemed to lead to the dark cathedral’s basement.
target: Id videbatur ducere ad hypogaeum obscurae cathedralis.

source: Lumian paused, then blurted out, “You mean, this leads directly to Death’s palace?”
target: Lumian pausavit, deinde subito exclamat: “Intellegesne hoc iter directe ad palatium Mortis ducere?”

source: Based on the Knight of Swords’ explanations and what he had seen earlier, Lumian believed Death’s palace was situated at the bottom of the dark Underworld.
target: Ex explanationibus Eques Ensium et id quod antea viderat, Lumian credidit palatium Mortis in imo obscuri Orci situm esse.

source: One would have to keep heading downward, deep into the ground, to reach it.
target: Oportet incessanter deorsum procedere, in terram profunda, ut ad eum perveniret.

source: But since it was a descent, jumping directly into the seemingly bottomless “basement” might also be feasible.
target: Sed cum descensus esset, directe in hypogaeum, quod quasi inexhaustum videbatur, salire etiam fieri posset.

source: Emperor Roselle once said, “All roads lead to Trier!”
target: Imperator Roselle olim dixit: “Omnes viae ad Trier ducunt!”

source: The decaying goat‐faced Demon nodded slowly.
target: Daemon vultu caprino putrescens lente annuit.

source: It was only then that Lumian realized: This fellow understands my Intis language!
target: Tunc tantum Lumian intellexit: hic vir linguam meam Intis intellegit!

source: Why did I even bother getting a translator?
target: Cur quidem translator comparare studui?

source: Is a Demon still a Demon even after death?
target: Num daemon etiam post mortem daemon permaneat?

source: Lumian didn’t waste any time confronting the decaying goat‐faced Demon.
target: Lumian tempus non perdidit daemon vultu caprino putrescens oppugnando.

source: He ran a few steps to the edge of the dark, vast hole.
target: Currit paucos gradus ad limitem cavum obscuri et vasti.

source: He formed a clump of blazing white flame and placed it at the edge of the hole, illuminating some of the interior: massive stone pillars, blackened wood racks, collapsed stone slabs, and a winding staircase extending downward, disappearing into the darkness.
target: Constituit conglobatum flammae albae fulgidissimae et posuit ea ad marginem cavum, quae interiora illustrabat: columnas lapideas ingentes, armaria lignea atrata, laminas lapideas collapsas, et scalas tortuosam deorsum porrigentes, quae in tenebras evanuebant.

source: “No problem,” the Knight of Swords conveyed the judgment on behalf of the temperance faction demigod.
target: “Nulla quaestio,” tradidit Eques Ensium iudicium pro semideo factionis temperantiae.

source: It leads to Death’s palace.
target: Illud ducit ad palatium Mortis.

source: Without hesitation, Lumian jumped onto the partially collapsed staircase.
target: Sine mora, Lumian in scalas partim collapsas salivit.

source: Instead of running down the stairs in the usual way, he jumped back and forth between stone pillars, wood racks, staircases, and walls in a linear free‐fall.
target: Pro eo quod ex scalibus more solito descenderet, inter columnas lapideas, armaria lignea, scalas, et muros in libero, lineario lapsu saliebat.

source: During this process, Lumian occasionally transformed into a blazing white flame spear to leap over completely collapsed parts without footholds and at other times turned into a shadow creature to navigate around special areas.
target: Per hoc processum, Lumian interdum in hastam flammae albae fulgidae se transformabat, ut partes omnino collapsas sine sustentatione superare posset, et alias in creaturam umbratam convertibat ad spatia specialia circumvaganda.

source: The surrounding darkness seemed to hide something, something even the blazing white light couldn’t illuminate, but Lumian ignored it, pretending not to notice.
target: Tenebrae circumiectae aliquid celare videbantur, aliquid, quod etiam fulgens alba lux lucrare non potuit, sed Lumian id neglexit, simulans se non animadvertere.

source: After descending for an indeterminate amount of time, Lumian’s feet finally touched the ground.
target: Postquam per spatium temporis indefiniti descenderat, pedes Lumiani tandem terram tetigerunt.

source: In the light of the blazing white flame, he saw that the area was littered with broken bones, some white, some yellow‐brown, and some dark brown.
target: Sub luce flammae albae fulgidissimae, vidit regionem ossibus fractis sparsa esse, quaedam alba, quaedam flavo–brunnea, et quaedam fuscobrunea.

source: Not too far from Lumian, a deep black stone wall stood, set with a heavy wooden door large enough for a giant to pass through.
target: Non longe a Lumiano stabat paries lapideus nigerrimus, ornatus ostio ligneo ingenti, sufficiente ut gigantem transire permitteret.

source: Lumian walked up to the door, bent over, and extended his palms, beginning to push outward with all his strength.
target: Lumian ad ostium accessit, inclinatus, et palmas extendens coepit omni vi propellere.

source: His instincts told him that beyond this door lay Death’s palace.
target: Instinctus eius indicaverunt ei quod ultra hoc ostium palatium Mortis iaceret.
